summary: This is a current report (8-K) filed by Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. to disclose a fourth amendment to its license agreement with Tanabe Pharma Corporation. The amendment terminates future royalty obligations, broadens the license to exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, and irrevocable, and includes a one-time $200M cash payment plus up to $100M in new commercial milestones (with up to $255M in remaining pre-existing milestones). Upon a change of control, the new milestones accelerate. No shareholder approval, tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. This is a routine contractual amendment, not a special situation.
